title: Steiner Shortcut Conjecture
formal: Are there absolute constants \(C>0\) and integers \(a,b\ge0\) such that every finite directed graph \(G=(V,E)\), with \(n=|V|\ge2\), \(m=|E|\ge1\) and no isolated vertices, has an augmentation \(G_{+}=(V\cup V_{+},E\cup E_{+})\) with \(|E_{+}|\le Cm(\log(n+2))^{a}\), preserving reachability between every ordered pair of original vertices exactly, in which every reachable original pair is joined by a directed path of at most \(C(\log(n+2))^{b}\) arcs?
definitions: Graphs are unweighted, finite and simple as directed graphs; opposite arcs are allowed. An isolated vertex is incident to no arc. The finite set \(V_{+}\) is disjoint from \(V\), and added arcs may have endpoints in either set. Reachability allows the empty path. Preservation means that for every \(u,v\in V\), a path from \(u\) to \(v\) exists in \(G_{+}\) if and only if it exists in \(G\). The path-length bound counts arcs and applies only to pairs in \(V\times V\). No thickness bound is imposed on consecutive Steiner vertices. Constants precede the quantifier over graphs. This is an existence statement with no construction-time requirement; unused isolated Steiner vertices may be omitted.

context_blocks.text: A long directed path represents a long chain of dependencies. Shortcuts ask how compactly the same reachability relation can be represented with short paths.

The original conjecture allowed extra arcs only between old vertices and was refuted. Conjecture 2 of the cited paper permits additional Steiner vertices; the known old-vertex lower bounds do not settle this statement.

The representation may preserve a large reachability relation without listing every reachable pair. Existence would settle a structural compression question, while efficient parallel construction is a separate algorithmic demand.

why: This is a central structural question about compressing directed reachability, with consequences for understanding the obstacles to efficient parallel graph algorithms.
answer_criterion: Prove the stated existence claim or its logical negation, with the specified model, quantifiers and guarantees. A conditional lower bound settles only its conditional claim. Benchmark acceptance requires a complete mathematically correct proof checked in Lean; a partial improvement does not meet the target.

sentences: A Steiner shortcut augments a directed graph with new vertices and arcs.
Reachability between all original vertices must remain exactly the same.
The conjecture asks for near-linear many added arcs and polylogarithmic paths between reachable original pairs.
The earlier conjecture forbidding new vertices was refuted, while this version remains a distinct structural question.
The target concerns existence and does not impose a fast construction algorithm.
